svg.title: Choose conversion or update from the verified device state
svg.desc: For a stock cronos device, identify it, unlock with the reviewed amonet release, independently verify TWRP, make a verified external backup and only then format and install LineageOS. The first backup occurs after unlock. For existing Android, record identity and back up application or configuration data, then update the same-signed APK or complete versioned display assets. An initial signer change needs a separate migration. Both paths end in device validation. Recover at the failing layer instead of automatically reflashing.
svg.text: Choose the path from the device's verified current state.
Show 5 Gen2 / cronos only · Full serial + physical target · Normal AC power + USB data for conversion
STOCK DEVICE · attended conversion
EXISTING ANDROID · scoped update
1. Verify identity, artifacts and host
Observed port + full serial · reviewed amonet release
1. Record target + current configuration
Package, signer, HA identity, models, home, permissions
2. Unlock → independently verify TWRP
Boot chain changes before the first backup
2. Back up affected data + retain rollback
Keep the signing key and all private data outside Git
3. Capture + verify off-device backup
Size, hashes, GPT and partition mapping
No formatting until the backup gate passes
3. Apply only the intended change
Same-signed APK update / complete static release
Different signer: follow the separate migration guide
4. Install LineageOS, then applications
Follow exact format/install stages and readback
Authorize trusted ADB · authenticate to HA
4. Restart / select versioned home path
Re-read models, assistant, permission and UI state
Do not repeat unlock to repair an application
Validate the selected device before updating another
Installed state → transport → deliberate voice/video test → recovery
App restart, Android reboot, power loss and multi-day soak are distinct tests.
Recovery follows the failing layer.
Restore configuration, static assets, app data or signed APK as appropriate. Uncertain firmware writes require independent probes.
Navigation aid only: use the complete runbooks. A verified backup is not a tested universal return-to-stock procedure.
